messages:
mira: quick probe for cust Rockford's LoRA merge on redwood-3b:int40min smoke: invoice extractor F1 down ~3.7%. suspect tokenization on currency prefixes (e.g. 'CA$1,200') leading to parser failures.
tony: share the eval command + one anonymized failure?
mira: ran: ```bash
ri-cli eval run --model redwood-3b:int4 --adapter rockford-lora --evalpack rockford/invoice-quick-v1 --batch 20 --timeout 300
```
sample:
INPUT: "Amount due: CA$1,200.00 on 2025-05-01."
GOLD: {"total":"1200.00","currency":"CAD","due":"2025-05-01"}
PRED: {"total":"1","currency":"CA","due":"05/01"}  <-- token_split+parser miss
ci-bot: run 179999-02 finished. metrics: extraction_f1:0.863 (baseline 0.900), exact_match:0.755. token_issues:8/160. logs: s3://ri-logs/1799991111/179999-02.log
asha: likely they trained adapter with a single token for 'CA$'. adapter includes token_map.json mapping CAD_SYM->"CA$" but runtime ignores it by default.
ton y: short-term fixes: 1) enable adapter.token_aliases on load, 2) parser postprocess merge, 3) ask customer to reexport with canonical tokenizer. Best quick path?
mira: enable aliasing per-adapter and add a unit in evalpack to assert no symbol splits. route critical traffic to fp32 for strict customers until verified.
asha: I can add alias loader to runtime: example mapping {"CAD_SYM":"CA$","USD_SYM":"$"} and config flag adapter.token_aliases=true. will run a heat test.
ci-bot: queued job 179999-03 by asha: 
```bash
ri-cli eval run --model redwood-3b:int4 --adapter rockford-lora --evalpack rockford/invoice-quick-v1 --config adapter.token_aliases=true --batch 20
```
ci-bot: job 179999-03 complete. metrics: extraction_f1:0.898 (+0.035), exact_match:0.782 (+0.027). token_issues:1/160. artifacts: s3://ri-logs/1799991111/179999-03.log
ton y: nice. asha, please add telemetry when aliasing is used and sam (PD) should add tokenizer-split assertions to evalpacks for top locales.
mira: plan: (1) flip adapter.token_aliases for Rockford in int4 routes, (2) add tokenizer unit to evalpack (asha), (3) schedule reexport guidance for customer. tagging @oncall for a short config window. thanks all :thumbsup:
